rules: Use a dedicated authorized Development fixture institute and synthetic records for write scenarios.
Production checks are non-mutating on existing authorized documents unless separately approved controlled testing exists.
Confirm GET handlers are non-mutating before invoking them: report recalculation and print/email routes can have side effects.
Do not run SQL, create payments, issue stock, ingest RFID, send external notifications or alter approval routing against live systems from this CI workflow.
Record actor, institute, release SHA, document IDs, expected/actual results, correlation IDs and reviewer without credentials or confidential payloads.

checks.development: Use a synthetic active account; check successful login, denied invalid/expired token, and current-user identity.
checks.production: Inspect existing authenticated session and /health; never treat health alone as database or worker acceptance.

checks.development: Create an authorized synthetic PR, verify requester/institute, initial approval members and queued notice; reject foreign scope.
checks.production: Read an existing authorized request; do not submit a new PR.

checks.development: Approve/reject synthetic steps, verify independent active member, transaction rollback and next-step notices with V2 disabled.
checks.production: Read existing route/history; do not decide or change approvals.

checks.development: Assign/reassign eligible same-institute fixture buyers; test unauthorized/foreign/inactive denial and audit/outbox evidence.
checks.production: Read current assignment and history without running autoassignment.

checks.development: Invite and submit synthetic supplier responses; prove competitor isolation and authorized same-institute award provenance.
checks.production: Read an existing authorized event; avoid report recalculation, invitations and submissions.

checks.development: Issue an approved fixture PO with independent approval and valid technical/budget authority; verify audit rollback and duplicate prevention.
checks.production: Read existing PO and issuance evidence; never issue a new PO.

checks.development: Receive partial/full fixtures, verify quantity conservation and a single stock movement on retries.
checks.production: Read receipt and linked ledger evidence without posting a receipt.

checks.development: Attest independent review, reject/quarantine/release as authorized; verify rollback, signatures and accepted quantities.
checks.production: Read signed clearance/history; never submit an acceptance decision.

checks.development: Issue only accepted available fixture stock and distinguish department fulfillment from warehouse intake.
checks.production: Read existing fulfillment/provenance; never issue stock or acknowledge receipt.

checks.development: Exercise scoped lifecycle, canonical financial projection and explicit reconciliation with historical values unchanged.
checks.production: Read an authorized contract and canonical projection; do not edit, reconcile or settle.

checks.development: Post a verified fixture invoice liability with segregation of duties; failed audit/outbox must roll back posting.
checks.production: Read existing posted voucher/payable and balance; never post an AP entry.

checks.development: Allocate synthetic partial/full payments, reject overpayment/duplicates/foreign scope, and verify actual audit INSERT failure rollback.
checks.production: Read existing settlement/allocation evidence; never create or alter a payment.

checks.development: Use synthetic reader/client identities to ingest, crash/restart, recover stale leases and reject duplicates or foreign ownership.
checks.production: Read authorized queue/history and original client/reader status; do not ingest/recover/process live jobs.

checks.development: Verify committed business audits, before/after/source evidence, rollback and read-only missing-history diagnostics.
checks.production: Read authorized existing audit evidence; never fabricate or backfill history.

checks.development: Use stubbed transport; verify durable intentions, recipient revocation, stale recovery and ambiguous acknowledgment behavior.
checks.production: Inspect scoped operations counts/age/dead letters; no test email or replay without separate approval.

checks.development: Reconcile canonical completion totals, currency-specific projections, scoped filters and exported fixture cohorts.
checks.production: Read approved non-mutating reports; do not run a GET/export that recalculates or writes evidence.
